mq_missing_chunks.interpretation: MQ array metadata is present but image chunks are absent. Reads silently return fill-value zeros. Three sampled public Zstd/HQ counterparts contain nonzero pixels. Cause and downstream embedding/mask provenance impact are not established.
mq_missing_chunks.inventory_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over lexically ordered site keys, each followed by a newline; separately for every object suffix. The observed chunk digest equals the digest of the public site index minus the listed 119 affected sites.

Sampled Zstd/HQ counterparts contain nonzero pixels. These same chunks are missing locally; 113 affected sites also have published mask records. Cause and downstream impact require investigation.
